name: team-task-manager
description: Full-stack team task manager with RBAC

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: cd client && npm ci --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm ci --legacy-peer-deps && npx prisma generate && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
